{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "max_tokens": 8000, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Emergency department visits and wait times at three metro hospitals, Jan-Jun 2024

The county health department compiled per-visit records from three hospitals for January through June 2024 to assess a new triage diversion policy.

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    drawn to answer: Which hospital and department waits longest
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by visit_date, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    drawn to answer: How wait time moved over the half year
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(wait_minutes, satisfaction), unit minutes, points
    drawn to answer: Do longer waits go with lower satisfaction
- `f04`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by hospital, quarter, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 is titled 'Minor'
    p1: grouped_bar, grouped by hospital, quarter, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p1 is titled 'Moderate'
    p2: grouped_bar, grouped by hospital, quarter, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p2 is titled 'Severe'
    the panels are related by: small_multiples
- `f05`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p1: bar, grouped by severity, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p2: bar, grouped by day_of_week, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p3: bar, grouped by month, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    the panels are related by: facet
- `f06`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p1: grouped_bar, grouped by hospital, department, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f07`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0: category_line, grouped by hospital, SUM(cost), unit USD
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric
- `f08`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0: category_line, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    its subtitle is already fixed as '2024-01-01 to 2024-03-31'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f10`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    its subtitle is already fixed as '2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f11`
    p0: pie, grouped by day_of_week, AVG(cost), unit USD
- `f12`
    p0: box, grouped by department, FIVE_NUM(satisfaction), unit points
- `f13`
    p0: table_chart, grouped by hospital, severity, COUNT(*)
- `f14`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by day_of_week, quarter, AVG(satisfaction), unit points
- `f15`
    p0: area, grouped by visit_date, hospital, MAX(cost), unit USD
- `f16`
    p0: heatmap, grouped by month, department, COUNT(*)

## What to write

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | What the figure shows. Name the quantity and how it is broken down |
| `subtitle` | The qualifier: what each mark covers, over what period |
| `unit` | The unit the values are in, as it would be written on an axis |
| `column_names` | One readable name per column below, used on axes and in legends |

Columns to name: `cost`, `day_of_week`, `department`, `hospital`, `month`, `quarter`, `satisfaction`, `severity`, `visit_date`, `wait_minutes`

Rules: no numbers except years and quarters; no findings, comparisons or
directions; no chart-type words; title under twelve words.
